technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish structure (RSI14, supertrend, hull) but weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.15), poor volume support (CMF negative, OBV flat), and price below key moving averages—moderate risk swing entry requiring tight stops.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 16 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; mixed signals warrant caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (333.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings binary event in 16 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technicals (RSI14, supertrend, hull bullish) + extreme fear sentiment (23/100) create contrarian swing opportunity near support (206.97) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional support, earnings in 16 days), price below both 50/200 MAs, and weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.15) make this a high-risk binary event trade.
